fullPassage: If there is little or no diversity of views, and all scientists see, think, and question the world in a similar way, then they will not, as a community, be as objective as they maintain they are, or at least aspire to be. The solution is that there should be far greater diversity in the practice of science: in gender, ethnicity, and social and cultural backgrounds. Science works because it is carried out by people who pursue their curiosity about the natural world and test their and each other's ideas from as many varied perspectives and angles as possible. When science is done by a diverse group of people, and if consensus builds up about a particular area of scientific knowledge, then we can have more confidence in its objectivity and truth.

as many varied perspectives and angles as possible
a particular area of scientific knowledge

questions.passage: If there is little or no diversity of views, and all scientists see, think, and question the world in a similar way, then they will not, as a community, be as objective as they maintain they are, or at least aspire to be. The solution is that there should be far greater diversity in the practice of science: in gender, ethnicity, and social and cultural backgrounds. Science works because it is carried out by people who pursue their curiosity about the natural world and test their and each other's ideas from as many varied perspectives and angles as possible. When science is done by a diverse group of people, and if consensus builds up about a particular area of scientific knowledge, then we can have more confidence in __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 합의가 쌓이면 '객관성과 진실'에 대해 더 큰 신뢰를 가질 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① diversity of views — 관점의 다양성 (본문에 있으나 confidence in의 대상으로 문맥 부적합)
✅ ② its objectivity and truth — 객관성과 진실. 다양한 집단의 합의 → 객관성 신뢰 ←정답
❌ ③ social and cultural backgrounds — 사회적·문화적 배경 (본문에 있으나 confidence in의 대상으로 부적합)
❌ ④ the natural world — 자연 세계 (본문에 있으나 confidence in의 대상으로 의미 부적합)
